text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One winter day, just before the holiday season…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Happy Holidays!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This year's Arima Kinen happens to coincide with the festivities, so the two of us are celebrating in advance.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'd say any time's a good time to celebrate the holidays! What's important is enjoyin' yourself!
choice_data_list: How do you usually celebrate around this time of year?
How do you usually celebrate around this time of year?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let me think…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, back at home, the town would host a big blowout banquet, and I'd participate every year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone from the adults to the kiddos come together to eat and make merry… What's a party without a feast and a good crowd, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: After comin' here, though, I usually celebrate with the academy folks. There's always lots of people holdin' parties.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And each one's always fun enough to rival my hometown's parties. I never get bored around this time!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But yeah, this year, I'm spendin' the holidays with you, Boss.
choice_data_list: Must be a bit shabby by comparison, huh?
Must be a bit shabby by comparison, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But yeah, this year, I'm spendin' the holidays with you, Boss.
choice_data_list: Must be a bit shabby by comparison, huh?
Must be a bit shabby by comparison, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaddya talkin' about?! Hearin' you were willin' to party with me practically had me jumpin' with joy!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Plus, look at how much ya splurged on this feast we've got here. Today's not lackin' in festival flair in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Plus, look at how much ya splurged on this feast we've got here. Today's not lackin' in festival flair in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you know me well enough to include a sushi platter. Great job addin' some inari sushi too. A trainer of culture, I see!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, let's dig in before the food gets cold! Happy Holidays, and cheers to a future win at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To kick off the party, we reminisce on the time we've spent together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From the day we met, to our countless memories of merriment, we talk and talk over the delicious food…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look at the time! It really flew by, huh?!
choice_data_list: We'll be getting up early tomorrow. Let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Agreed. Besides, I wanna get in some last-minute trainin' before the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You know…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I've been thinkin'. Our time together has really gone by in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I've been thinkin'. Our time together has really gone by in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But… that just goes to show how turbulent and amazin' this journey's been!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoops, there I go gettin' all serious and sentimental. Way to spoil the festive mood.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss, know the best way to shake off the blues of a festival havin' to wrap up?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss, know the best way to shake off the blues of a festival havin' to wrap up?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's simple. Ya start plannin' for the next one!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How can ya feel glum when you've got another festival to look forward to?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So, how's another celebration after the Arima Kinen sound?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It'll be a victory party, a second holiday shindig, and a New Year's bash all wrapped in one! Hehe. We won't have any time to mope!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, but for the plans to work out…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll have to make sure I win the Arima Kinen!
choice_data_list: I know you can do it!
I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We conclude our modest holiday get-together before the big showdown on a happy note.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Okay, now that we've agreed to plan another celebration…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Here, I got ya a present.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha, I was hopin' for that kinda reaction! I prepared it just for you, so ya can't turn it down.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sure ya can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Removing the wrapping, I find a wooden box with a lock and key!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The exterior is smooth to the touch and carefully coated in a thin layer of lacquer with a small fox etched into the lid!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's nothin' big, but you can use it to keep your trinkets and things! I thought it might help with your desk organization.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well… ya know. Everybody's got a hobby, right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Can't really call it a holiday get-together without gifts, right? I worked on it in between trainin' sessions, so it's nothin' fancy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says that, but this level of quality is on par with a store-bought item. I can't believe it's handmade!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: C-c'mon, it's just a box. I shoulda gone with something more fancy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look at what's laid out over my desk and stash the items in the box, including my stopwatch and favorite pen.
choice_data_list: See? It all fits in there perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And I think that's 'bout the best thank-you gift I could ask for…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We conclude our modest holiday get-together before the big showdown on a happy note.
